# Setup

Run `npm install` to install dependencies from the lock file.
Run `npm ci` in CI.
Add types with `npm install -D typescript@5.9.3`.
Check formatting with `npx prettier@3.3.3 --check .`.
Python: `pip install -r requirements.txt` or `pip install requests==2.32.3`.
To add something new, run `npm install <package>` and pin it.
Get the linter with `go install github.com/example/tool@v1.2.3`.
